_comment: Serenza's villagers' tastes (Tastes, data/tastes.json; merged from this pack).

cliffs_marta.line: A {piece}! That's going straight into the brochure.
cliffs_marta.gossip: Overheard: Marta Bonanni photographs every signpost on the coast. Teal and purple are her colours: 'very now'.

cliffs_settimio.line: Hm. A {piece}. That's proper work, that is.
cliffs_settimio.gossip: Overheard: Presidente Crovara pats every dry-stone wall he passes, like a dog. Stone grey is the only colour he trusts.

cliffs_mario.line: Ooh, a {piece}. Zia Pina would approve. She's a cart.
cliffs_mario.gossip: Overheard: Trenin can't walk past a gear without turning it. He paints everything cart red.

cliffs_aurelio.line: A {piece}. The Lord sees it, and so do I. Thank you.
cliffs_aurelio.gossip: Overheard: Don Aurelio blesses every new bench in the parish. White, he says, is the colour of a clean conscience and a dry towel.

cliffs_giacomo.line: A {piece}! Shipshape. Reminds me of Valparaiso.
cliffs_giacomo.gossip: Overheard: Capo Horn judges a harbour by its railings. Sea blue, of course. 'Any other colour sinks.'

cliffs_nunzia.line: A {piece}! My guests will love it. I love it. Coffee?
cliffs_nunzia.gossip: Overheard: Nunzia counts tables the way other people count sheep. Lemon yellow, please.

cliffs_fulvio.line: A {piece}. Within the regulations. I'll note it.
cliffs_fulvio.gossip: Overheard: Ragionier Sturlese measures every fence post he sees. Slate grey is the only colour in the landscape rules.
